name: Markdown to HTML
description: Converts Markdown text in a field (bold, lists, links, headings, tables) to HTML in a new field, keeping the other fields.
introductoryText:
![](data:image/png;base64,)
### Markdown to HTML

Converts the Markdown text in one field into HTML, in a new field after the input fields.

**How to set it up**: choose the field with the Markdown. The HTML goes in a field called `HTML` unless you name it otherwise; give it the Markdown field's own name to replace that field. Untick **Keep the input fields** to output only the HTML.

**Tables, fenced code and footnotes** (ticked by default) adds the common extensions to standard Markdown. Empty values stay empty. HTML already in the text is passed through unchanged, so only convert text from sources you trust if the HTML will be shown in a report.

options.name: outputField
options.title: HTML field name
options.description: Name of the new field holding the HTML. Use the Markdown field's name to replace it.

options.name: includeInput
options.title: Keep the input fields
options.description: Output the input fields with the HTML field after them. Unticked, only the HTML field.

options.name: extensions
options.title: Tables, fenced code and footnotes
options.description: Also convert tables, fenced code blocks, footnotes, abbreviations, definition lists and attribute lists (the 'extra' extension). Unticked: standard Markdown only.

blockOutputs.label: HTML
blockOutputs.tooltip: The input records with the Markdown converted to HTML in a new field.
